For his crimes, Rubens was charged with first-degree murder and is currently held without bond awaiting trial. Friedelene's daughter filed a $5 million lawsuit against the city of Boynton Beach and Officer Germain Jones, alleging gross negligence. Body camera footage revealed that Officer Jones allegedly mocked Daniel's accent, minimized the threat, and failed to separate her from Caesar, who had followed her right into the station lobby. The city of Boynton Beach filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit. City attorneys argued that under Florida law, police officers do not have a legally actionable duty to protect individuals from third-party criminal acts. A Palm Beach County Circuit Court judge heard arguments against the dismissal in March 26. The judge gave both sides time to file additional arguments before issuing a final ruling on whether the lawsuit can proceed to mediation or trial. An internal affairs investigation by the Boynton Beach Police Department resulted in Officer Jones receiving a two-week suspension without pay and a manner. mandatory 120 hours of domestic violence training.
